name: Trello board
description: Your Trello board in prifly: log in with your own Trello account, start a session from a card with its text, comments and pictures, and keep the card on that session's banner.

settings.label: Post a summary on the card when a session is archived
settings.description: Ticked at first in the archive dialog: the session gets one more turn to write what it did, for the people on the board, and posts it on the card with pictures of the change. Untick it there to skip it once.

settings.label: Move the card on archive to
settings.description: The column the archive dialog picks first for a session's card, e.g. Done or Review (any case). Empty leaves the card where it is.

launch.label: From a Trello card…
launch.description: Your board. Logging in and choosing which board live here too. The session starts knowing the whole card: description, comments, checklists and every attached picture.
